facts.fact: FEWS NET's October 2026 Southern Africa seasonal monitor reports well-above-average NDVI vegetation and above-average soil moisture in Lesotho.
FEWS NET says its Seasonal Monitors, which cover Lesotho in the Southern Africa edition of 26 October 2026, are produced every 10 to 30 days during the rainy season.
